title: Order Cancellation Terms, Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
## Cancellation terms

These terms govern the cancellation of a Cartwise Grocery Orders order and what is billed when an order is canceled.

**1. When an order can be canceled.** An order can be canceled only before checkout, that is while it is placed or shopping. After checkout it cannot be canceled, because cancellation after checkout is not allowed on any service level; item problems are handled as refunds instead. The order's status on the order record decides this.

**2. Who confirms.** Only the customer can confirm a cancellation.

**3. Cancellation while placed.** A cancellation confirmed while the order is placed (before shopping) is free: nothing is billed, and a priority upgrade redeemed on the order is returned to the Cartwise+ Membership.

**4. Cancellation while shopping.** A cancellation confirmed while the order is being shopped (during shopping) bills the service level's cancellation fee, as a cancellation fee, and no other fee, no item and no tip is billed.

### By order status

| Order status when the customer confirms | Can be canceled | Billed on the order |
|---|---|---|
| Placed | Yes | Nothing; a redeemed priority upgrade goes back to the membership |
| Shopping | Yes | The service level's cancellation fee only |
| En route, ready for pickup, completed, returned or closed (after checkout) | No | — item problems are handled as refunds |

### Points of judgement

- *The shopper has started shopping and the customer confirms the cancellation* — the order is canceled during shopping; the cancellation fee of the order's service level is billed and nothing else (clause 4).
- *The order is on its way to the customer* — checkout has happened, so the order cannot be canceled (clause 1).
- *A member who redeemed a priority upgrade cancels before shopping starts* — nothing is billed and the upgrade is returned to the membership (clause 3).
